subject: Initiative triage and cross-functional asks ahead of QBR
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Initiative triage and cross-functional asks ahead of QBR

Team —

Quick check-in ahead of the August QBR. I ran a light sweep of the top-level OKRs and we need to make a couple of pragmatic choices so we can present crisp asks and mitigations to the execs. Summary: two initiatives are at risk and both require cross-functional tradeoffs.

High-level status (current / target):
- Latency SLO rollout (infra + runtime): 40% / 80% by EOW
- Caching & Cost Optimization (runtime + infra): 30% / 65%
- Sales Enablement (docs + CS): 70% / 100%

Observed blockers and proposed quick scopes:
1) Latency SLO rollout
   - Blocker: infra capacity scheduling and kernel tuning backlog.
   - Proposal: scope down to critical endpoints only (control plane + high-traffic models) for this quarter; move lower-traffic models to phase 2. This reduces expected infra work by ~40%.
   - Ask: Vivek — can you confirm whether we can de-prioritize model X and Y without regressing region SLAs? Need feasibility note by EOD Thurs.

2) Caching & Cost Optimization
   - Blocker: integration with prefix cache library + evaluation harness.
   - Proposal: ship cache for text-generation path first; defer embeddings caching until next quarter.
   - Ask: Laura — product needs to update success metrics (tokens saved / latency) and sign off on acceptance criteria by Fri.

3) Sales Enablement / Customer comms
   - Blocker: we promised clearer cost guidance for Acme pilot.
   - Ask: Hannah — can you own the dependency tracker and coordinate a short runbook + outreach email to Maria by Thu morning? We'll attach the runbook to the QBR deck.

Attached: QBR_deck_v2.pptx (draft) and dependency_tracker_20260728.csv (stub).

Next steps:
- Short feasibility notes from Vivek + Laura by EOD Thu.
- Hannah to circulate dependency tracker updates and proposed customer email.
- I will consolidate and send the exec-facing slide by Friday 3pm PT.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiative triage and cross-functional asks ahead of QBR

Thanks, Stephanie. Quick note from infra/serving perspective.

Feasibility and constraints:
- We can scope to critical endpoints as suggested. De-prioritizing models X and Y reduces the kernel tuning and can buy ~3 weeks of runway for the team. However, the tradeoff is slightly higher p95 for admin-console workloads that occasionally spike.
- We are tight on cross-region capacity the week of Aug 9 due to a scheduled cloud maintenance (INF-7921). If that maintenance is not movable, our earliest full rollout shifts to late Aug.

Concrete asks / commitments:
- I can confirm the model de-prioritization impact by Thu EOD. If we need to keep region parity, we should consider a short-lived burst GPU reservation (2 weeks) — cost estimate attached in the tracker.
- I'll update the dependency_tracker_20260728.csv with infra blockers and a recommended mitigation (burst vs phased rollout) by Thu 12:00pm.

One more thing: for the caching work, we need a small MLP (0.4 FTE) from runtime performance to validate the quantized kernels. That is a hard dependency unless we accept a lower accuracy threshold.

-Vivek
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initiative triage and cross-functional asks ahead of QBR

Appreciate the crisp ask, Stephanie. A few product/metrics items to capture before we finalize scope: 

- For Latency SLO rollout, acceptance criteria should include: p50/p95 baseline, user-visible errors (5xx) threshold, and customer experience note for Acme (we need to confirm their primary endpoints). I can get the metric mapping done but will need input from Vivek on which models end up in "phase 1."
- For Caching & Cost optimization, the success metric should be tokens_saved_per_100k and regional cost delta. If we only do text-gen path this quarter, adjust targets to 40% of the original cost-savings number.

Potential security/compliance ask: Acme's procurement team asked for a short data retention note tied to caching behavior. We do not need the whole SOC2 package, but a one-page statement OK for the QBR. Hannah — can you coordinate with Security and add that to the dependency tracker?

I will update the product acceptance criteria and push a version to the doc link (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcdefgQBR-notes) by Thu noon.

-Laura
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

On it — I'll own the dependency tracker and the Acme outreach. Plan:
- Update dependency_tracker_20260728.csv with owners, jitter windows for infra maintenance (INF-7921), and the short runbook for the customer email by Thu 9am PT.
- Ping Security for a one-page cache/data retention note; target EOD Thu for a draft.
- Draft customer email to Maria and share with Stephanie for sign-off before sending.

Will post updates directly to the Drive QBR assets folder and tag the doc.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Customer Success (Acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 17:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initiative triage and cross-functional asks ahead of QBR

Thanks everyone — solid alignment. Quick consolidation for the thread so we have a single source to copy into the QBR slides: 

Decisions agreed:
- Latency SLO rollout: scope to critical endpoints (phase 1). Vivek will confirm by Thu EOD which models are in/out.
- Caching: ship text-generation path this quarter; embeddings caching deferred. Laura to reduce metrics target to 40% of original.
- Customer comms: Hannah to own outreach and security note for Acme.

Deliverables and owners (due dates):
- Vivek: model phase list + infra mitigation recommendation (Thu EOD).
- Laura: updated acceptance criteria & metrics doc (Thu noon).
- Hannah: dependency tracker update + draft customer email + security one-pager (Thu 9am / EOD for security doc).
- Stephanie: compile exec slide + finalize QBR deck (Fri 3pm PT).

I'll take the lead on the final slide language and call out the tradeoffs for the execs (cost vs time-to-rollout). Please flag any blockers in the tracker; if we need a quick sync, I'll set up a 30-min slot tomorrow afternoon.

Attachments (referenced):
- QBR_deck_v2.pptx (draft, 18 slides)
- dependency_tracker_20260728.csv (owners + initial mitigation rows)

-Stephanie
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
